# ankra_cloudflare_domains (Data Source)

Lists the Cloudflare zones a connected credential reaches, for the `zone_id` of `ankra_cloudflare_dns_record`. The counterpart of `ankra org cloudflare domains`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_cloudflare_domains" "main" {
  credential_name = "cloudflare-main"
}

output "zone_ids" {
  value = { for domain in data.ankra_cloudflare_domains.main.domains : domain.name => domain.id }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `credential_name` (String) Credential whose zones to list. Unset uses the organisation's only Cloudflare credential.

### Read-Only

- `domains` (Attributes List) Zones the credential reaches. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--domains))
- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the data source.
- `is_truncated` (Boolean) Whether the platform stopped walking Cloudflare's pages before the end, so `domains` is incomplete.

<a id="nestedatt--domains"></a>
### Nested Schema for `domains`

Read-Only:

- `account_id` (String) Cloudflare account that owns the zone.
- `id` (String) Cloudflare zone id.
- `name` (String) Zone name.
- `name_servers` (List of String) Cloudflare name servers to delegate to.
- `paused` (Boolean) Whether Cloudflare is paused for the zone.
- `status` (String) Cloudflare zone status, such as `active` or `pending`.
- `type` (String) Zone setup type, such as `full`.
